sentences.en: The strong wind cut the electric wires in several places.
sentences.zh: 强风在几个地方切断了电线。

sentences.en: If you touch that wire, you will receive a shock.
sentences.zh: 如果你触碰那根电线，你会受到电击。

sentences.en: I wired him a message of congratulation on his graduation.
sentences.zh: 我给他汇了一条祝贺他毕业的消息。
